title: Implement get/set/delete/list CLI commands

title: Implement Keychain backend

title: Implement backend abstraction and 1Password backend

Implement 1Password backend using op CLI: get via op read, set via op item create (with overwrite detection + --force), delete via op item delete, list via op item list. Vault=guppi, titles=SERVICE/KEY, tags=SERVICE.
